binding.parser_policy: Exact canonical single [1/1] header; malformed/multiple/mismatched headers and contradictory/duplicate known markers raise invalid-log RuntimeError; coherent same-name footer plus optional matching official marker, or named timeout/Benchmark-died plus No-benchmark-was-run; nonzero exit required for final failure; all partial timings unscored
binding.ownership_policy: Skip provably older unknown parent-PID rows from ownership; identity-only refusal context; all other guards unchanged

dormant_worker_admission.scope: Only this exact node identity. Any lifetime CPU-counter change, new child, changed command or live parent invalidates timing; no counter reset between phases.
